description: Append text to a periodic note (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly). Preserves existing frontmatter exactly. Creates the note first (from template if configured) when createIfMissing is true (default).

content.description: Text to append to the note body.

createIfMissing.description: Create the note if it does not exist before appending. Default true.

date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when omitted.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

name: append_periodic_note
